senses.gloss: (sec. r. of גור) to travel about; to trade (= h. סָחַר).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 42:34">Targ. Y. Gen. XLII, 34</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 21:14">Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 14</cite> (v. infra).

senses.gloss: same. Targ. II Esth. VIII, 13. Targ. O. Deut. l. c. תִתַּגַּר ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. תִתָּגַר; Y. תִיתְגַּר Pe.; h. text תתעמר). Targ. O. ib. XXIV, 7.—Trnsf. to make profit, to be benefited (cmp. אֲגַר II, III).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 2b:17">Ab. Zar. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>אִיתַּגּוּרֵי אִיתַּגוּר וכ׳</he> should they have profited (by their disobedience)? if so, the sinner would be rewarded; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 38a">B. Kam. 38ᵃ</cite> (not <cite ref="A00338"><he>אתגר</he></cite>); Yalk. Hab. 563.

<cite ref="Yevamot 92b:4">Yeb. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>איתגורי איתגר וכ׳</he> should he profit (by his disregard of the law)? if so &c. Y. Ter. IV, 42ᵈ bot. <he>מִתַּגַּר ליה וכ׳</he> he gains four quarters (of a Kab); a. e.
